mechanism: Tretinoin is highly teratogenic and ACE inhibitors are contraindicated in pregnancy; concurrent use increases risk if contraception fails, and tretinoin may theoretically increase enalapril levels through CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Ensure reliable contraception in women of childbearing potential; counsel on teratogenic risks of tretinoin and ACE inhibitors in pregnancy; monitor for hypotension and hyperkalemia.
